examples.name: SQLite Basic
examples.description: Basic database operations with SQLite including connection, queries, query builder, and transactions
examples.learningGoal: Introduce database programming with the lightest-weight MALDA database client.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints SQLite usage patterns and transaction examples.

examples.name: SQL Server Basic
examples.description: Basic database operations with SQL Server including connection, queries, query builder, and transactions
examples.learningGoal: Show how the same MALDA data concepts scale to enterprise-style SQL Server workflows.
examples.expectedOutput: Demonstrates SQL Server connection, querying, and transactions.

examples.name: PostgreSQL Basic
examples.description: Basic database operations with PostgreSQL including connection, queries, query builder, and transactions
examples.learningGoal: Transition from local SQLite concepts into a production-style PostgreSQL client workflow.
examples.expectedOutput: Demonstrates PostgreSQL connection, querying, and transactions.
